# Dear ImGui

This directory contains a trimmed Dear ImGui docking-branch snapshot downloaded
from <https://github.com/ocornut/imgui> on 2026-08-26. The downloaded sources
identify themselves as `v1.93.0 WIP`.

Only the core library and the Win32/DirectX 11 backends used by Project
Gilgamesh are retained. The upstream examples, documentation, miscellaneous
utilities, demo implementation, and unused backends were intentionally removed.

See `LICENSE.txt` for the upstream MIT license.
